Unnamed: 2: ATTR (TTR amyloidosis). Transthyretin, produced by the liver, transports thyroxine and retinol to the liver.
The liver secrets TTR into the blood. TTR may be redundant given the function of thyroxine-binding globulin
Phase I FIH n=6 ATTR - NCT04601051, NEJM 2021
Phase III n=50 ATTR-PN ex-US sites only
